name: Tactical Master (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Assault Leader, Advanced Rogue Talents.

Benefit: A rogue with this talent may use Assault Leader an additional 1 time per day for every 5 Rogue levels she possesses. Assault Leader may not be used more than once per round.
